hook: One Rust library replaces your whole VoIP stack.
hookText: A VoIP stack written in Rust

beats.say: rvoip is a Rust library that bundles SIP, RTP, WebRTC and voice AI agents behind one call model. There is no separate SIP proxy, media server or RTP engine to install.
On a single cloud server, it sustained eight thousand three hundred forty eight sessions per second of SIP signalling over TLS.
With encrypted media flowing, it still set up eleven hundred twenty four calls per second, using the standard RFC benchmark with zero failed calls.
